section.catchline: Commission to send notice to delinquent taxpayer.
section.subsection: The commission shall, within three business days after the day on which the commission provides a notice of levy described in Section 59-1-1707 to a depository institution, notify a delinquent taxpayer that the commission has issued the notice of levy to the depository institution.

The notice described in Subsection (1) shall:
state the amount subject to levy as stated in the notice of levy described in Section 59-1-1707; notify the delinquent taxpayer that the depository institution is required to secure the amount subject to levy in accordance with Section 59-1-1708; identify each account subject to levy at the depository institution; and describe the actions a delinquent taxpayer may take to: satisfy the liability; or resolve an issue as to whether the commission has the authority to receive from a depository institution the amount subject to levy at the depository institution.
